title: Uniquely Buttery Brazilian Sour Cream Quiche
description: A rich and creamy Brazilian quiche recipe featuring full-fat sour cream, crispy bonito flakes, and a mediterranean-inspired twist.
instructions: Roll out the pie crust and place it in a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a large skillet, sauté the onion and bell pepper until softened.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg yolks, sour cream, and grated cheese.
Add the cooked onion and bell pepper mixture, bonito flakes, salt, and black pepper to the egg mixture, stirring to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into the pie crust and top with sliced black olives.
Dot the top of the quiche with unsalted butter.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve warm, garnished with additional bonito flakes if desired.
